subject: Walled environment pricing playbook — commit sizing, KMS & audit questions
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@fintecho.co>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@fintecho.co
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Single-tenant pricing + KMS/audit scope (Fintecho)

Hi Aditya / Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week — the Dedicated pool with private tenancy looks like a good fit for our production use. A few procurement items we need clarified to take this to our SRE and procurement teams:

- Rough sizing: we expect ~300 sustained inference RPS (95th percentile peaks up to ~500 RPS) for our priority model. That maps to approx 8x A100-equivalent GPUs in steady capacity, with burst to 12.
- Compliance: we require customer-managed KMS for key separation, immutable audit logs (90-day hot, 2-year cold), and evidence for SOC 2/ISO mapping.
- Pricing: we need a clear breakdown: reserved commit (monthly $), isolation premium, KMS add-on (per-month), audit log storage pricing, and any per-request throughput guarantees or credits if SLOs miss.

I attached our demand forecast and the procurement questionnaire (see attachments). Can you send a packaging recommendation (3 options: minimum, recommended, and compliance-heavy) and the expected discounts for 12/24/36 month commits? Also confirm whether the isolation premium is a % uplift on commit or a flat per-pool fee.

Goal: get an internal LOI by Mar 18. Happy to set a short call this week if helpful.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Head of AI Infrastructure
Fintecho Capital

[attachment: Fintecho-Demand-Forecast.csv]

From: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@fintecho.co>, procurement@fintecho.co
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Single-tenant pricing + KMS/audit scope (Fintecho)

Samantha — thanks for the clear ask and the forecast. High-level proposal below; I included an attachment with a first-pass quote. We can tighten numbers after a quick sizing call.

Summary (three packaging options):

1) Essentials (minimum)
- Reserved commit: 8x A100-equivalent (steady), monthly list: $88,000
- Isolation premium: 18% uplift on the reserved commit (applies to all compute + infra usage)
- KMS: optional, managed integration fee $1,500/mo + key policy configuration (customer-managed keys supported)
- Audit logs: 90-day hot at $0.12/GB/mo; cold retention priced at $0.02/GB/mo
- Burst capacity: add-on hourly pool at 50% of list rate; on-demand throttle fallback otherwise
- SLA: 99.5% monthly for latency SLO; credits available (see quote)

2) Compliance (recommended for regulated workloads)
- Reserved commit: same sizing; pricing: commit discount applied (see below)
- Isolation premium: 15% uplift + one-time tenant onboarding fee $12,000 (provisioning, KMS attestation)
- KMS: $1,000/mo (pass-through for HSM/KMS footprint + integration)
- Audit logs: 90-day hot at $0.10/GB/mo, cold $0.015/GB/mo; log handing includes WORM controls
- Evidence package: SOC2 scope mapping + periodic evidence collection (add-on)

3) Platinum (SLA & support)
- All Compliance features + 24/7 on-call & 4-hour remediation SLA; isolation premium: 12% uplift (because of longer commit)
- Dedicated CSM + quarterly operational review; tailored playbook for incident response

Discount/commit guidance:
- 12 months: 10% off base commit list
- 24 months: 15% off
- 36 months: 20% off + one-off onboarding credit (negotiable)

Notes on isolation premium: it is applied as a percentage uplift on the compute+infra line items (not a flat pool fee). This keeps costs proportional to capacity and usage; we can offer a capped flat-fee for larger pools on request.

SLO / credit mechanics:
- We provide latency and availability SLOs tied to the committed pool size. Credits are tiered (partial credits for p95 latency misses; month credit up to 15% for major outage). We can carve a contractual clause for minimal guaranteed throughput (test harness) as part of the SOW.

Attached: Redwood-Dedicated-Quote-v1.pdf (line-item table, assumptions, and SLA appendix).

If that direction looks good I’ll loop in legal/finance for a draft SOW. Want to jump on a 30m call today at 3pm PT?

— Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai
[attachment: Redwood-Dedicated-Quote-v1.pdf]

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@fintecho.co>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@fintecho.co
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Single-tenant pricing + KMS/audit scope (Fintecho)

Thanks Aditya — this is helpful. A couple quick clarifications before we loop in procurement formally: 

- Is the isolation premium a single percent applied to everything in the commit, or are there components that are excluded (e.g., audit store or network egress)?
- For KMS: can you support our Azure Key Vault HSM (customer-managed) and restrict Redwood staff key access? Any additional costs for BYOK integration beyond the monthly KMS line item?
- The SLA credit language: are credits automatic or require an RCA/claim? Procurement prefers automatic credits triggered by metric thresholds.

Also — on discounts: our procurement team will be more comfortable if there is a predictable break point for bigger commits. If we go to 24 months with a 25% commit (vs current 100% steady), what additional discount can you do beyond the listed tiers?

We can do a call at 3pm PT today; please send the invite.

Best,
Samantha

[attachment: Fintecho-Procurement-Questions.docx]

From: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Single-tenant pricing + KMS/audit scope — internal margin check

Internal — forwarding Fintecho thread. Highlights / asks from procurement below. Need guidance on how much flexibility we have on: isolation premium treatment (percent vs exempt storage), BYOK integration engineering cost, and an aggressive discount for a 24-month, 25% increased commit.

Quoted from Samantha: "If we go to 24 months with a 25% commit (vs current 100% steady), what additional discount can you do beyond the listed tiers?"

My thinking: keep isolation premium applied to compute and infra only, exempt audit cold storage (we pass through storage at cost). Offer BYOK integration as a one-time engineering fee + reduced monthly KMS pass-through. For the discount, we could match 24mo -> 22% (vs 15%) if they commit to a 25% expansion mid-term; 36mo stays at 20% base but allow an additional variable rebate tied to utilization. Thoughts?

— Aditya

On Wed, Mar 10, 2027 at 09:28 AM aditya.rao@redwood.ai wrote:
> Samantha — thanks for the clear ask and the forecast. High-level proposal below; I included an attachment with a first-pass quote. We can tighten numbers after a quick sizing call.

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: aditya.rao@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Single-tenant pricing + KMS/audit scope — internal margin check

Aditya / team — prefer to be surgical and keep margins intact while offering procurement a simple commercial hook. Recommended path: 

1) Isolation premium scope: apply as % uplift to compute + runtime infra only; explicitly exclude audit cold storage and egress. Call out storage as "pass-through at cost" in SOW.

2) BYOK/BYOK-HSM integration: one-time engineering integration fee $18,000 (covers Azure Key Vault / EKV / HSM mapping & attestation). Monthly KMS pass-through: $1,000/mo. If customer wants Redwood-managed keys, discount the integration fee by 50%.

3) Discounting mechanics: give the listed 12/24/36 bands, but make an "expansion credit" for multi-year commits: if they increase commit by 20%+ within first 12 months, grant an additional 6% rebate on incremental compute for the remaining term. For the 24 month ask (25% commit bump up-front), approve a commercial concession to 22% off base commit (instead of 15%), contingent on signature before Mar 25 and no concurrent market crediting.

4) SLA credits: set automatic metric-triggered credits for availability; RCA required for latency credits. Keep maximum monthly credit at 15% and exclude credits for maintenance windows with notice.

5) Onboarding credit: offer a one-time $10k credit against first invoice for 36-month deals.

If you want I can draft a short commercial summary for procurement and a fallback concession to limit legal churn.

— Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Commercial
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: aditya.rao@redwood.ai
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@fintecho.co>, procurement@fintecho.co
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Single-tenant pricing + KMS/audit scope (Fintecho) — proposed commercial summary

Samantha — thanks for the quick back-and-forth. Based on our internal review here is a concise commercial package you can take to procurement: 

- Baseline commit: 8x A100-equivalent reserved pool. List price: $88,000/mo.
- Isolation premium: 18% uplift applied to compute and runtime infra line items only (audit cold storage & egress excluded; those are pass-through at cost).
- KMS: support for Azure Key Vault BYOK (customer-managed) — one-time integration $18,000 + $1,000/mo pass-through. If you prefer Redwood-managed keys we can drop integration to $9,000 and manage the keys.
- Audit logs: 90-day hot at $0.10/GB/mo, cold at $0.015/GB/mo; WORM/immutability controls included in Compliance package.
- Discounting: 12mo = 10% / 24mo = 15% (we can make 24mo = 22% if you agree to a 25% larger commit immediately and sign by Mar 25) / 36mo = 20% + $10k onboarding credit.
- SLA credits: automatic for availability misses; latency credits require RCA; monthly credit cap 15%.

Next steps: let me know whether Procurement prefers the BYOK or Redwood-managed keys path and whether you want the 24mo accelerated concession. If yes, I’ll circulate a short term sheet and request LOI to lock the pricing for procurement review.

Available for a 30m call today at 3pm PT if that helps.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai
